Frequently asked questions

Is this a sales call?

No. It’s a diagnostic. You leave with a specific read on your gaps and clear next steps, whether or not you ever work with us.

Why ₹43 and not free?

Free sessions get free-session attendance. ₹43 signals that both sides are serious: you prepare, and so do we.

I’ve done workshops before. How is this different?

Workshops are built for a room of 30. This is a 1-on-1 diagnostic built around your seniority, industry and patterns.

I’m not sure I have a communication problem.

That’s a good reason to book. Many of our learners thought they were good communicators. The gap was consistency in high-stakes moments.

I’m too busy right now.

Then this is the highest-leverage hour you can spend. Busy schedules are exactly why the gap exists.

What if I don’t continue after the session?

Completely fine. You keep the diagnosis and the next steps.
